app_tagline: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [ଓଡ଼ିଆ] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [or] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [or] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [or] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [or] Type or speak your question for the helper...
